authority_rules: Familiarity is not permission, ownership, proficiency, certification or action authority.
Vocabulary labels classify familiarity subjects only; they do not mutate owner taxonomies or canonical entity state.
Explicit unknown remains unknown and cannot be inferred into familiarity.
KFR-01 defines no transfer percentage, confidence degradation, hierarchy traversal or automatic competence.
Hidden/private knowledge is filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation or AI context.
